clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says he once had a single technique run on him - what he calls a money process - and within weeks he was making millions of dollars, calling it his Midas touch.

So he tried it on a friend without telling him. The friend was living in a studio apartment at the time and had no idea anything had changed.

Within a couple of months, that friend was a millionaire.

Would you want to know if someone was quietly rooting for your biggest year yet?

#kevintrudeau #manifestation #lawofattraction #mindset #success #wealth
clips.send: A broke friend sends it to another broke friend, in awe that help can arrive before you even ask for it or know it is coming.
